Edge and vertex permutation chains give character 1-f_P-f_L+f_I for bipartition-preserving automorphisms and t_I-1 for reversing ones, including polarity trace absolute_points-1. PG(2,4) orthogonal/unitary absolute-point counts 5 and 9 yield traces 4 and 8. General theorem structural, not extrapolated from small cases.
